Epic: bd-01KX1A0D296NNAFYH6ZN2HRD2K

Follow-on plan:
- Lift chunk input into a scheduler-neutral stream/iterable abstraction.
- Keep shared core free of Spark/runtime dependencies.
- Provide interpreters for sequential local execution and bounded Future execution.
- Leave JVM-only distributed adapters as a later interpreter over the same typed chunk contract.
set.title: Fit: scheduler-neutral chunk interpreter
